meta.title: Quick Ballpark
meta.subtitle: A short spoken interview. No sketch, no tape measure on every wall.

chooser.title: How do you want to estimate this job?
chooser.quickHint: About a dozen spoken questions. Get a preliminary range in a few minutes.
chooser.detailedHint: Walk room by room, describe the work and approve every scope item.

persistence.error: Could not save interview progress. Your offline draft is retained.

voice.transcriptHint: Edit this if we heard it wrong.
voice.unsupported: Voice input is not available on this browser. Type your answer instead.
voice.notUnderstood: We could not read that answer. Say it again or type it.

cannotRead.dimension: We could not read a measurement there. Try "18 feet", "18 ft" or "18 by 16".
cannotRead.count: We could not read a number there. Try "2" or "two doors".
cannotRead.choice: That answer did not match any of the choices above. Tap a choice or rephrase.
cannotRead.text: Please type or say a short description.

lengthFt.hint: You can say "sixteen by eighteen" and we'll fill in both.

partitions.hint: A rough sense is enough — we'll show the allowance we use.

partitionLfKnown.prompt: If you know the partition length, say it
partitionLfKnown.hint: Leave this blank to use our allowance.

raisedFloor.prompt: Does the floor need to be framed up?
raisedFloor.hint: Common over a sloped garage slab.

plumbing.prompt: How far is the plumbing moving?
plumbing.hint: Distance to the nearest existing drain.

roomType.prompt: What kind of space is this?

sizeClass.hint: A size class only — we'll show the footprint we assume.

scopeType.prompt: What kind of work is it?

layoutChange.hint: Moving walls, doors or the room's function.

wallRemoval.hint: Load-bearing walls change the number a lot.

optionalDimension.hint: Optional. Skip it and we'll use the size-class allowance.

plantingStockSize.prompt: What size is the plant stock?

plantingAccess.prompt: How do crews reach the planting area?
plantingAccess.hint: Machine access changes the labor a lot.

proximityRisk.prompt: Is the work near a structure, footing or buried utility?
proximityRisk.hint: This may require locates and hand digging.

spoilsDisposal.prompt: Do spoils or debris need to be hauled away?

beamSpanFt.prompt: How long is the clear span?

bearingCondition.prompt: Is the load path to the foundation confirmed?

temporaryShoring.prompt: Is temporary support needed during the work?

beamFinishMethod.prompt: How should the beam and posts be finished?

patchScope.prompt: How much drywall patching is involved?

builtInLengthFt.prompt: How long is the built-in work?

cabinetRunFt.prompt: How long is the cabinet run?

bathFixtureScope.prompt: Do fixtures stay in place or move?

showerWaterproofing.prompt: Does the wet area need waterproofing?

result.title: Preliminary range
result.preliminary: This is a preliminary range, not a fixed price.
result.widenSummary: The band is widened {{total}}% overall, including {{source}}% for what this intake path cannot verify.
result.previewNote: Your current saved range is {{low}}–{{high}}. This preview replaces it only when you tap "Use this ballpark".
result.positionGroupLabel: Select where in the range you are selling this job
result.positionHint: Same scope and pricing settings — only the selling position inside the preliminary range changes.
result.invalidTitle: Pricing incomplete — this is not a $0 quote
result.invalidBody: This project has real scope, but none of it could be priced yet, so no range can be shown. Resolve the items below (usually a missing measurement or an unmatched task) and recalculate.

warning.sampleData: Pricing uses illustrative sample data, not market rates. Replace it with your own costs before quoting.
warning.noDimensions: Without length and width we cannot derive quantities.
warning.noLines: No priceable work yet — answer a few more questions.
warning.assumedFootprint: The room size is an allowance, not a measurement. Add dimensions to tighten the range.
warning.photoInference: Photo-based inputs are limited to what a person confirmed from the images.
warning.inferredFootprint: Room size was inferred from photo scale references, not measured.

after.later: Add sketch or exact measurements later
after.laterHint: Your answers stay on the project. Exact measurements will replace the assumptions without restarting.

toast.applied: Ballpark measurements saved. Refine them any time.
toast.failed: We could not save that. Try again.
toast.noChanges: No changes — your estimate is unchanged

intake.title: How are you estimating this job?
intake.subtitle: All three paths use the same ballpark engine and show the same assumptions.

onsite.title: On-site walkthrough
onsite.hint: You're at the property: spoken questions, rough dimensions, what you can see.

photos.title: Estimate from photos
photos.hint: Remote estimates when you have photos but limited measurements.
photos.help: Works for anything photo-first — a homeowner's phone pictures, an insurance packet or a realtor package.

description.title: Describe your project
description.hint: Voice or typing only. No photos or measurements needed.

photos.title: Add photos
photos.hint: Add whatever you have. Photos set the context — we only record what you confirm.
photos.noMeasurements: We never read dimensions off a photo. Anything size-related comes from you or from a labeled allowance.

describe.title: Describe your project
describe.hint: Say or type what you want done. A few short questions follow.
describe.placeholder: Example: convert the two-car garage into a studio with a full bathroom…

obs.cabinetsPresent: Are there cabinets in the photo?
obs.visibleDamage: Any visible damage or water staining?

ledger.title: What this number rests on
ledger.completenessHint: How much of the high-impact information we have. Not a claim about market accuracy.

risk.plumbingRelocationNote: Drain lines and venting can swing the price once the floor or wall is opened.
risk.structuralNote: Removing a wall may need a beam, an engineer's letter and a permit.
risk.concealedConditionsNote: Nothing behind the finishes has been verified on this path.
risk.electricalServiceNote: A panel or service upgrade is a large, separate cost.
risk.permitsNote: Permit fees, inspections and code upgrades vary by jurisdiction.
risk.selectionsNote: Finish choices can move the total substantially in either direction.
risk.accessNote: Parking, stairs, elevators and working hours affect labor.
risk.assumedFootprintNote: No verified dimensions yet — the footprint comes from the size class you chose.
risk.inferredFootprintNote: Dimensions were scaled from standard objects in the photos. Onsite measurement can move the price.

disclaimer.counselReview: Template wording only. Have business counsel review the production disclaimer before launch.

preliminary.title: Preliminary estimate — not a quote
preliminary.body: This is a preliminary ballpark range based on the information available so far. It is not a bid, a contract, or a guaranteed price. The final price depends on:

rendering.title: Renderings are conceptual
rendering.body: Any rendering shown with this range is a concept image. It does not represent verified dimensions, actual products, or the finished result, and pricing shown alongside it remains preliminary.

scale.title: Size the room from what you can see
scale.hint: Pick an object in the photo and tell us how many of them fit across. Standard objects make good rulers.
scale.disclaimer: These are approximations from standard object sizes, not measurements.
scale.allowCrossAxis: This photo's perspective supports using this object across the other direction

axisGuide.roomLengthFt: Count across the floor, left to right along the longer wall. Only floor-level objects count.
axisGuide.roomWidthFt: Count across the floor, wall to wall on the shorter side. Only floor-level objects count.
axisGuide.ceilingHeightFt: Count upward, floor to ceiling. Heights only — a door height works here.
axisGuide.cabinetRunLf: Count along the front of the cabinet run, left to right.

inference.title: Photo inference summary
inference.disclaimer: Preliminary only. Sizes are approximated from standard objects and must be verified by onsite measurement.

rejected.unknownReference: That reference object is not in our catalog.
rejected.invalidSpans: We need a count greater than zero.
rejected.elevationCrossAxis: A height off the floor (a door, a switch, a countertop) cannot tell us how wide or long a room is. Use a floor-level object instead.
rejected.axisMismatch: That object measures the other direction. Pick one on the same axis, or confirm the perspective under Advanced.
rejected.notAPhotograph: Object-scale calibration only works on a room photograph, not on a sketch or rendering.
rejected.cabinetsNotConfirmed: Confirm that cabinets exist before sizing a cabinet run.
rejected.implausibleResult: That result is outside a plausible room size, so we set it aside.

warning.elevationCrossAxis: A vertical reference was used across the floor. Those values were rejected and confidence is set to low.
warning.sketchNoObjectScale: Object-scale calibration was skipped because these images are a sketch or rendering.
warning.implausibleDimension: A calculated dimension fell outside a plausible range and was replaced with a documented allowance.
warning.tinyFloorArea: This floor area is too small for the room type. Something is off — confirm the dimensions before using this range.
warning.doorHeightCalibration: Length and width both came out near a standard door height, which usually means a vertical reference was used across the floor. Confidence is low.

analysis.title: What we can say from these images

note.noVisionProvider: No image-analysis service is connected, so nothing here was read from the pixels. We use the image kind you pick, your answers and documented size allowances — never invented dimensions.
note.noPhotos: No images yet. You can still continue: the range will come from your answers and broad size classes.
note.sketch: This looks like a sketch or floor plan, so object-scale calibration is switched off. Tell us the overall dimensions if the drawing shows them.
note.rendering: A rendering is a design image, not a measurement. We will use broad size classes instead of object scale.
note.detail: These look like detail shots. They are good for materials and damage, but they cannot establish room size.
note.unknownKind: We could not tell what these images are. Set the image kind so we treat them correctly.
note.unresolved: Some high-impact basics are still unknown, so the range stays wide until you answer them.
note.exterior: These are exterior shots — they say little about interior finishes or room sizes.
note.damage: Existing-condition shots flag problem areas; they do not size the room.

analysis.nothingYet: Nothing to summarize yet — answer a few questions and this fills in.

basis.kindSelected: Based on the image kinds you picked
basis.sizeAllowance: Documented size-class allowance, not a measurement

saveError.validation: Some answers could not be saved as entered. Nothing was lost. Reference {{reference}}.
saveError.server: Saving failed on our side. Your answers are still here — try again. Reference {{reference}}.

assumptionsReview.title: Review assumptions
assumptionsReview.hint: Everything the range rests on. Change anything that is wrong before we calculate.
assumptionsReview.disclaimer: Photos are weak clues, never measurements. Anything still unknown widens the range.

resolved.title: You've already answered the key questions for this estimate
resolved.body: Nothing important is unresolved right now. Your saved answers, project measurements and current scope already cover what the Ballpark needs.

q.scopeClarifier.prompt: What work are we doing here?
q.scopeClarifier.hint: Describe the job in a sentence — we'll build the right questions from it.
q.fixtureCount.hint: Count sinks, toilets, tubs and showers being set.
q.pipeRunLf.prompt: How much new pipe run, in feet?
q.pipeRunLf.hint: Total supply and waste run you expect to install.
q.pipeMaterial.prompt: What pipe material are we working with?
